articles.title: A Dragon Packed with 6,500 Pounds of Space Goodies Is Heading to the ISS!
articles.summary: Imagine a space delivery truck carrying 6,500 pounds of supplies—that's about as heavy as a small elephant! A SpaceX Dragon is blasting off to the International Space Station with cool experiments like watching bacteria grow in space and testing wooden bones.

articles.title: This Bug-Killing Chemical Wipes Out Termites but Won't Hurt You!
articles.summary: Scientists found a chemical that kills 95% of sneaky drywood termites by stopping them from growing a new shell. Even cooler? It's safe for people and pets because it only attacks the stuff insect shells are made of.

articles.title: Medicare Will Soon Cover Weight Loss Drugs—But There's a Catch!
articles.summary: Starting July, some people with Medicare can get popular weight loss shots like Wegovy for just $50 a month. But the program only lasts 18 months, and the $50 doesn't count toward your yearly drug cost limit.
